ink.displayName: Sheet Ink (Dark mode: ink-dark #f3f4f8 (--sheet-ink flips to near-white, so every ink band, rule and pressed chip becomes light))

paper.displayName: Sheet White (Dark mode: paper-dark #171923 (the sheet turns dark navy-black))

ground.displayName: Sheet Ground (Dark mode: ground-dark #0b0b12 (page background behind the sheets))

detail-blue.displayName: Detail Blue (Dark mode: #8ea6ff (the two blues swap so the light blue reads on the dark page))

detail-blue-on-ink.displayName: Detail Blue on Ink (Dark mode: #2748d6 (swaps with detail-blue, since ink bands are light in negative print))

well.purpose: Recessed well under the open rival row on the player page, a step darker than paper. Dark mode #0e1120.

win.purpose: Victory result text on paper (4.5:1). Dark mode #5fd38a.

loss.purpose: Defeat result text, error notice border and text, invalid field border. Dark mode #ff7b80.

display.purpose: Rival name h1 and sheet-button lettering; uppercase Big Shoulders Display 800, zero tracking.

headline.purpose: Section headings, copy strips, ink-band titles, scores and game-line day numerals.

title.purpose: Player names on convocado lines (Courier Prime bold).

body.purpose: Courier Prime typewriter default for lines, meta, fields and empty states.

label.purpose: Blue uppercase tracked labels: nav, field labels, sort label, ranks and units.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: The system has no elevation shadows. Depth comes from 3px ink rules, hairline rules, ink bands and the paper-to-ground step. Legacy --shadow-* tokens are remapped to '0 0 #0000' under .sheet-world. Inset box-shadow is used only to draw 3px borders on Nuxt UI select triggers and the color-mode toggle, and the double printed ring inside the crest.

motion.name: ease-sheet
motion.purpose: --sheet-ease: overshooting ease for the stamp landing and the ficha lift.

motion.name: duration-stamp
motion.purpose: The one authored motion: SUSPENDIDO stamp scales 1.5 to 1 at -8deg; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: duration-ficha-lift
motion.purpose: Linked ficha cards lift translateY(-3px) on hover, only with hover and no reduced-motion preference.

narrative.overview:
The public home is one team sheet for the next game, printed in black ink on a white sheet with hard black rules. Black and white carry the page; a single blue marks details and nothing else. The sheet reads like a form filled in on a typewriter: heavy condensed capitals for names and headings, a monospaced typewriter face for everything written on the lines.

The system is flat and ruled. There are no cards, no radii, no soft shadows; structure comes from 3px black rules, hairline rules between lines, and full-bleed black and white strips. Density is that of a form: numbered lines, tabular figures, generous 44-48px tap rows. Copy is Spanish.

Migration status, stated honestly: only the public home (`src/pages/index.vue`) and the `sheet` layout have moved to this system. Other pages and the admin still use the earlier Nuxt UI look driven by `theme.css` and `app.config.ts` (brand #4f72e2 and related tokens), and those tokens stay in force there until each page migrates. The tokens below apply to the `.sheet-world` scope only.
keyCharacteristics: Black ink on a white sheet, with a light gray ground (#e4e5ea) behind the sheets.
One blue (#2748d6) for details only; on black it becomes a lighter blue (#8ea6ff).
Hard 3px black rules frame each sheet; hairline rules separate lines.
Square everywhere except the round crest.
One authored motion moment: the stamp landing.
Self-hosted type (Big Shoulders Display, Courier Prime), no external font requests.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue is for details: numbers, labels, tags, links, arrows, the stamp, the reserved slot. It never fills a surface, never becomes a button, and never appears as a large area. Black and white are the main colors.

rules.name: The On-Ink Blue Rule
rules.body: On black, details use #8ea6ff; #2748d6 is for white only.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number (shirt numbers, dates, times, scores, ranks) uses tabular figures so columns align like a form.

rules.name: The Caps Rule
rules.body: Display type is always uppercase with zero letter-spacing; only the label uses tracking.

rules.name: The Fixed Frame Rule
rules.body: The header, section nav and footer are always 768px (`max-w-3xl`) wide on every page, so the logo, the nav and the footer never move between pages. Only page content may be wider: the home, schedule and game detail use the same 768px column; the roster, the player profile and the statistics section (tabs, title, filters, lists) use 1024px (`max-w-5xl`). Never size the frame by page.

rules.name: The Ruled Depth Rule
rules.body: A surface is separated by a 3px ink rule or a hairline rule. No drop shadows, glows, or blurs.

dos: **Do** keep black and white as the main colors and use blue (#2748d6) only for details.
**Do** use #8ea6ff for blue on black surfaces.
**Do** separate content with 3px ink rules and hairline rules (rgba(11,11,18,0.22)).
**Do** set display type in uppercase Big Shoulders Display and everything written on the lines in Courier Prime.
**Do** use tabular figures for every number.
**Do** keep tap targets at 44px or more and underline links with 2px blue.
**Do** respect reduced motion by removing the stamp animation.
Build pages from the shared blocks in components/ui/Sheet (Title, Heading, Band, Totals, Message) and UiPositionLabel before adding new markup.
donts: **Don't** fill surfaces or buttons with blue.
**Don't** round corners or add shadows; the crest is the only circle.
**Don't** use a signup call to action on the home until the club adopts it; the reserved slot stays hidden.
**Don't** apply this system to the admin or the other pages until they are migrated; they still use the Nuxt UI theme tokens.

Don't add hard-coded hex colors or Tailwind palette utilities to sheet pages; use the --sheet-* tokens or their Tailwind form (bg-sheet-paper, text-sheet-win, fill-sheet-pitch). Only the Google logo keeps brand colors.
